snippet.title: Acorn Archimedes Game: Air Supremacy (1991 Acornsoft)
snippet.description:
Air Supremacy is a polygonal three-dimensional flight game by Superior Software released in North America in 1991. Published by Acorn-software for the Archimedes the game's title refers to the a position in war where a side holds complete control of air warfare and air power over opposing forces.
